name: Advisor Intelligence Demo Dataset (49 Financial -> opal-data-demo fake-PII clone)
description: Andrew-direct directive 2026-05-21. Goal: stand up a self-contained demo tenant for the Advisor Intelligence platform by cloning the entire 49 Financial dataset (s3://opal-data-bd/platinum/** -- 22,253 objects / ~4.7 GB; 168 advisors, 2,962 clients, 6,548 accounts) into a new bucket opal-data-demo with identical structure + data richness but every client, advisor, account, and the advisory firm itself replaced by realistic fake data. A demo Cognito login then renders the full Advisor Intelligence experience against fake data with zero real-PII exposure. Architecture is favorable: the dynamic serving Lambda (opal-partners-data) is already firm-agnostic (resolves the firm bucket from DynamoDB opal-users-v2 FIRM#{id}.s3Bucket) -- registering a demo firm needs NO Lambda code change. The project is overwhelmingly a data-engineering job (a deterministic seeded pseudonymizer that re-keys S3 paths AND rewrites content, reusing the production-vetted ADVI_ANONYM PII-field classification map) plus light infra/auth wiring. Approach: a static snapshot clone (not a demo pipeline). Audit + implementation design: docs/proposals/advisor-intelligence-demo-dataset-20260521.md; CTO brief: docs/briefs/cto-brief-advi-demov1-demo-dataset-project-20260521.md.
